request: STREQ-000105: an unchanged selected transfer line must not be blocked by edits to unselected SO lines
specApproval: not obtained (autonomous run); user explicitly authorized the selected-line fix
scope: SO-based Delivery transfer validation; preserve other regular-stock workflows
behaviors: Adding, removing, editing or reordering unselected SO lines after approval permits the saved selected transfer
A selected line is matched by its stable remote line identity; removing and recreating the same item is rejected
Selected item, quantity, REST quantity, unit, yard, backorder or fulfillment changes still stop transfer execution
SO identity, customer and header yard changes still stop transfer execution
The transfer and dependency allocations contain only the originally selected lines and quantities
Manual approvals and automatic approvals use the same selected-line check
A retry after remote commitment reuses the existing local and remote transfer
Non-Delivery regular-stock handoffs retain whole-order validation
existingContractChange: The two integration cases that blocked a selected material transfer on changes to a separate, unselected kit now require successful execution. Adapter validation of kit consistency and non-Delivery kit checks remain intact.
